structured.answer: I'd open an account at פסגות and buy the "ילין לפידות מחקה S&P 500 (4D)" fund, because the page marks that pair "הזול". With the page's example (10,000 ₪ now, 500 ₪ a month, 10 years, 7%) it says I'd end up with about 86,500 ₪. I might take אלטשולר שחם instead because I know the name and it's only 43 ₪ less.

stuck.why: 7% for 10 years should be about 70% more (~119,000). 86,492 looks way too low and I don't get why. Something about 'בכסף של היום' and 'אחרי דמי ניהול ומס'.
The fund it picks for me is ילין לפידות, which I don't know. אלטשולר שחם, which I do know, is right under it at −43 ₪. Hesitated over which to take.
The example uses 10,000 ₪ but I have 30,000. I didn't change it, so I don't know my own final number.

stuck.where: Account list, small number under each total (1,057 / 4,541 / 26,817)
stuck.why: Not sure what it is. Maybe the account's cost over 10 years?

findings.what: 86,492 ₪ looks way too low against 70,000 at 7% for 10 years. Nothing next to it simply says why (inflation? tax?)
Too many coloured tags on every fund row. I couldn't read them and they all look alike
The recommended fund is from a house I don't know, while a well-known one is right below it at almost the same result
The fund list is very long and runs into foreign funds with 'אין מחיר כאן'. Too many options
The small number under each account total has no label I could see
The example amount (10,000) isn't my amount, so the big number isn't really mine
The currency hedging section is long and full of percents and minus signs. I got bored there
The range 'בין +2,212 ל־−23,766 ₪' is scary and not explained
